title: Quiz the Recruits

{{Quest infobox | name = Quiz the Recruits | map = [[Image:Quiz_the_Recruits_map.jpg|200px]] | campaign = Nightfall | nationality = Elonian | region = Istan | type = Primary | given by = [[First Spear Jahdugar]] | given at = [[Chahbek Village (outpost)]] | preceded by = [[Into Chahbek Village]] or
[[Take the Shortcut (Skip Tutorial)|Take the Shortcut]] | followed by = [[Never Fight Alone]] }} Talk to some recruits to find out if they are ready for battle. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{Standard prerequisites |campaign = Nightfall }} ===Objectives=== * Speak to the first [[Sunspear Recruit]]. * Speak to the second Sunspear Recruit. * Speak to the third Sunspear Recruit. * See First Spear Jahdugar for your reward. ===Reward=== * 250 [[Experience]] ==Walkthrough== Speak to the three Sunspear Recruits and return to First Spear Jahdugar for your reward. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;First Spear Jahdugar :''Ahai, . The corsairs are swiftly overtaking the village. Before we head off to get our blades bloodied I need to make certain that these '''recruits''' know how to function as a team. Go '''speak''' to them. Rile them up and make sure they are going to inflict unspeakable pain upon the enemy. Make sure they know their stuff!'' {{offer dialog |accept = You can count on me. |decline = What do I look like, a school teacher? |ask = '''Speak''' to the three '''recruits''' before we head into battle. I need to make sure we can count on them when lives are at stake. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== ;Sunspear Recruit (first paragon) :''As a [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear]], you never fight alone. Forming your party is an important element of being an effective soldier. It's important to coordinate your efforts so your unit acts as a well-oiled machine. You may add [[Hero]]es to your group by selecting them from the dropdown menu in the [[party window]].'' ;Sunspear Recruit (second paragon) :''You must assume care over the men and women under your command. You can equip any of the Heroes in your party by bringing up the [[inventory]] panel and clicking on their portrait. From there you can outfit them with any type of [[weapon]]...even upgrade their [[armor]] with [[rune]]s. You'll also want to bring your Heroes out on a few adventures to get them some valuable [[experience]] in the field. As they gain experience, their [[level]]s will rise and they will gain Health, [[attribute point]]s, and improved [[Armor rating|armor]].'' ;Sunspear Recruit (ranger) :''Bringing proper [[skill]]s into combat is extremely important. You may only alter your skills, and the skills of those under your command, while you are in a [[town]] or [[outpost]]. To do this, simply open up the [[Skills and Attributes Panel|Skills and Attributes panel]] and drag and drop the skills you need onto your [[Skill Bar]]. Once you've set your skills, be sure to adjust the [[attribute]]s of your character and your Heroes. You can switch between yourself and your Heroes by clicking on the character icons at the top of the Skills and Attributes panel.'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;First Spear Jahdugar :''So they are ready to face the enemy head on? Good news, indeed. Let's show those unwashed corsair heathens what it means to challenge the Sunspears!'' ==Notes== {{anomaly|This is marked as a Primary Quest but is not required to proceed.}}
